title: SPO JAPAN GUILD - Continued of the Japan SPO community

ms.promise:
A) Weekly meeting minutes. (A meeting to share node updates and network changes with SPOs in the community)
B) SPO JAPAN GUILD DOCS update
C) Verification results of new versions of cardano-node and cardano-cli (Only when a new release candidate version is announced)
ms.criteria:
A) Weekly meeting minutes.(Since the agenda for each meeting is different, it is not possible to quantitatively measure the content of the meetings.)
・Take at least 3 meeting minutes per month. 
・At least 5 participants per meeting.

B) SPO JAPAN GUILD DOCS update
・At least one or more releases, including minor releases.
・Active user access for 50 or more individuals per month.

C) Translations and explanatory documentation of features added to the new version.(Only when a new release candidate version is announced)
